flags.why: The traditional time unit is 10,800 years, not sixty years ([Hán Nôm dictionary](https://hvdic.thivien.net/whv/會)).
flags.fix: cycle of 10,800 years; Người xưa tính một hội là mười nghìn tám trăm năm. = In the old reckoning, one hội was 10,800 years.

flags.why: This sense means to hunch or raise one's shoulders, not to square them or compare people's heights ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/so)).
The example describes comparing heights rather than hunching one's shoulders.
flags.fix: Trời lạnh, nó ngồi so vai rụt cổ. = It was cold, so he sat with his shoulders hunched and his neck tucked in.

flags.why: The skill or trick sense is used in ordinary speech and is not restricted to literary language ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/ngón)).
Cột điện means an electricity pole, not a telegraph pole.
flags.fix: The motorbike hit an electricity pole.

flags.why: Ngã does not encode staying down as a separate meaning ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/ngã)).
flags.fix: Merge into sense 1: to fall down; to topple over.

flags.why: Chai meaning one million dong is established Southern slang rather than rare usage ([slang dictionary](https://www.tudientienglong.com/word/1-chai)).
